evidence.exact_span: I saw the contempt application made by the applicant as just a further step by it against me in the proceedings which I thought were unjustifiable.
There is no suggestion that the respondent has any previous criminal history or history of contempt of court orders.

In these proceedings I found the applicant has satisfied me beyond reasonable doubt that the respondent was guilty on four charges of contempt in my judgment in Natural Floor Covering Centre Pty Ltd v Monamy (No 1) [2006] FCA 518.
